comment: The seven goals are outcome-framed, which is right, but none names a non-digital route. In every country a proportion of the population cannot or will not use digital channels. If the architecture's goals are achievable only digitally, the goals themselves encode exclusion.

public.text: The seven goals are outcome-framed, which is right, but none names a non-digital route. In every country a proportion of the population cannot or will not use digital channels. If the architecture's goals are achievable only digitally, the goals themselves encode exclusion.
public.suggestedRevision: Add to the goals, or to the design principles, that every function on which a right or entitlement depends must have a non-digital route of equivalent standing, and make it a go/no-go condition for deployment rather than an aspiration. In the Netherlands roughly one in five adults has limited basic digital skills and roughly one in three has difficulty finding, understanding and appraising health information, while 94% of 65–75 year olds use the internet daily. These are three different measures and are routinely conflated.
